label: EdgePoint Industrial — MQTT gateway
notes: MQTT driver (not Modbus). Set broker URL and Nexus serial number when applying. Device publishes JSON to /devices/<serialnum>/messages/events/ — tags use json: dot paths (e.g. json:inputs.0.9010 for AC_IN1). Output commands publish {"outputs":[{"reg":9410,"state":1}]} to /devices/<serialnum>/messages/devicebound/. External Modbus data appears on /devices/<serialnum>/messages/events/module — add tags manually with json:modbus.registers paths. Default broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883; set username/password on driver if broker requires auth. Assumes gateway firmware per EdgePoint Data Dictionary 230921.
